title: From Finite-Node Conifold Geometry to BPS Structures II: Functorial Incidence and Quiver Assembly
summary: In previous work, we extracted the intrinsic finite algebraic state data of a finite-node conifold degeneration in the form $A_Σ:= (V_Σ,E_Σ,c_Σ)$, where $V_Σ$ is the finite node-indexed vertex set, $E_Σ$ is the nodewise coupling space, and $c_Σ$ is the coefficient vector of the corrected global extension class. The purpose of the present paper is to construct the corresponding interaction and incidence layer.
